keys.hero.lore_vael_narration:
You want to hear about Ashford? Sit closer, then. The fire's warm, and this one's long. It was cold that morning. Mist on the river, frost on the wheat. You could smell the smoke from the town ovens. That's when the horns sounded off. They came over the ridge in a dark line... and the line kept coming. A thousand of them. Maybe more. Beside me, a boy from the mill dropped his spear and ran, followed by the man beside him, then all of them. And I sat there thinking... if I run too, Ashford burns. So I didn't run. Behind me, Carn and Aureth dragged the gates shut and held the city wall. The whole town ran them stones, water, anything they could carry. But somebody had to stay out front... and thin the horde before it ever reached that wall. I put my sword on my shoulder, walked into the gap where they had been... and I held it.

The first of them came screaming up the slope. I roared at them... and something inside me roared louder. And the whole first rank broke and scattered before a single one of them reached me! Then... I started slashing. One dead... five dead... twenty men slain by my sword. A spear found my side. Hot as a brand. I felt it go in... and I kept swinging. I took the spearmen's lives for it! An axe bit into my shoulder, and yet my next stroke came faster than the last! Fifty. Sixty. Seventy. The mud was red, and so was I. I should have fallen a dozen times. I didn't. Something in me wouldn't let me fall... it wanted more. Ninety-eight... Ninety-nine... One. Hundred! And I wasn't sated. That's the part I never tell. And do you know what I saw, in the faces of the ones still standing? They were more afraid of me bloodied, than they have ever been of me whole.

At the end, they closed around me like a fist. So I drove my blade into the earth... and I stood my ground. Nothing they did could put me down!

When the sun went down, the field was quiet. Just crows, and smoke... and one knight still standing. Red to the elbows. Breathing slow... and smiling. I didn't know I was smiling. To this day, they call me the Bloodknight.

After Ashford, they took my armour off me to wash it. It wouldn't come clean. The blood had dried into the steel... like it belonged there. And my sword. I swear its edge is keener now than the day it was forged. Every life it took... it kept something. Some nights I hear it counting... five-ten... five-eleven... five-twelve... One day, I'll let it finish.
keys.hero.lore_konwu_narration:
You want the story of the monkey? Ha! Sit down. Sit! It's a long one, and every word of it is true... ...mostly.

Before the Emberweave had a name, there was the Storm-Peak, a mountain tall enough to lean on the sky. And at its summit, I came out of the rock, the way water comes out of a spring. Nobody bore me. The mountain simply got tired of being still. The moment my eyes opened, I saw the whole world spread out below me, green and gold and wide... and the first thing I ever did was laugh. They called me... Kon! Wu!

Now, a mountain's child doesn't stay on a mountain. I looked down at the world... and then I looked up. Above the clouds there was a whole realm of jade roofs and silver bridges, where the sky-wardens walked on the air as if it were a floor. Nobody invited me. So I climbed the rest of the way myself. And everything they had, they kept locked away... so I unlocked all of it. I climbed the rest of the way into the sky-realm and helped myself to everything that wasn't nailed down. And then I went looking for whatever they'd hidden the deepest. ...and in the farthest vault, wrapped in silk, I found a staff that hummed when I picked it up... like it had been waiting for me. Ruyi. I should have left then. I didn't. I sat on their throne, drank their wine, and waited for someone to notice me. Oh... they noticed alright. A thousand sky-wardens, all at once, every one of them shouting my name like a curse! For this, the sky-realm threw me out!

They opened the floor of heaven right under my feet... and I fell straight through. Day one, I was furious. Day three, I was bored. By day six, I had counted every star and given them all rude names. I fell for nine days... and landed laughing! Then I didn't move for ten years. Dead to the world, flat on my back at the bottom of my own crater. When I finally opened my eyes... somebody had built a city on top of me. Oriel. The first city of the Emberweave. People came from everywhere to live in the crater I made. I didn't mind them. They were loud, and they cooked well.

But the part I do not tell... is what I found when I climbed out. The people who settled my crater had raised a shrine at its centre, facing upward... to the heaven that had thrown me down! They were grateful to it, for such a bountiful, deep hole. I have never been more insulted!! And I have been insulted by gods!

So I make sure I'm noticed. Every war this land has had... I was in it! ...mostly on purpose. Once, I threw a warlord's whole army into a lake... just to see if the splash would reach the sky.

But no war, no city, no warlord ever made heaven look down at me. Not once. Some nights, when the city's asleep, I sit on the edge of my crater and look up. I can still see their lights up there. Nobody up there ever looks down. So one day... I'm going back up. Nine days, it took them to throw me out. Let's see how long it takes them... to let me back in!
keys.ftut.market.1: Ooh, fresh stock! The Market restocks every hour: three stacks of hero fragments and a Peace Shield.
keys.ftut.market.2: Two stacks cost gold, one costs diamonds. The price is on the button. Tap it and the slot reads Sold.
keys.ftut.market.3: The Peace Shield keeps world-map attackers off your city for 12 hours. Quiet, bottled.
keys.ftut.market.4: Fragments make heroes. Buy them while they're here.
keys.ftut.shadymarket.1: Don't look at me like that. Shady Market: fixed stock, diamonds only, no questions asked.
keys.ftut.shadymarket.2: A War Chest is 80,000 gold for 250 diamonds. You can buy up to 25 a day.
keys.ftut.shadymarket.3: Protection Shields, Teleport Scrolls, Arena Coins. Same shelf every day, nothing rotates.
keys.ftut.wishing.1: Make a wish, darling! A Gold Wish costs 1,000 gold, and 3 a day are free, one every hour.
keys.ftut.wishing.2: A Diamond Wish costs 300 diamonds, with one free each day. It opens once you clear Stage 1-5.
keys.ftut.wishing.3: Bad luck streak? A full hero is guaranteed within 40 Diamond Wishes. I counted.
keys.ftut.wishing.4: 10 Wishes costs the price of nine. The ? beside the title shows the odds. Now wish.
keys.ftut.rankings.1: The Bulletin Board. Every name worth fearing is pinned here. Mine will be at the top.
keys.ftut.rankings.2: Your own standings sit up top: Arena rank, guild, campaign stage and how deep you are in the Vault.
keys.ftut.rankings.3: Below that, the top 20 in the Arena and the top 15 guilds. Read it. Pick a target.
keys.ftut.dungeon.1: The Vault. A hundred floors, two waves on each. We go down until something stops us.
keys.ftut.dungeon.2: Tap Select Heroes: five fighters and five backups. Then BATTLE to take the floor.
keys.ftut.dungeon.3: Every floor pays Forge Dust, gear fragments and glyph fragments. Every 5th is a boss with 2 glyph fragments.
keys.ftut.dungeon.4: Cleared floors can be swept: 2 free sweeps a day, then diamonds. And each hero earns 30 XP a floor!
keys.ftut.arena.1: The Arena. Real rivals, real teams. You climb by beating them.
keys.ftut.arena.2: Tap Challenge on someone ranked above you. Win and you take their place. Lose and it costs nothing.
keys.ftut.arena.3: You get 5 free fights a day, and Refresh brings new opponents, free 3 times a day.
keys.ftut.arena.4: Adjust sets the team that defends your rank while you're away. Spend Arena Coins in the Shop.
keys.ftut.skyisland.1: The Island of Trials! Three trials drift up here, and each one opens at its own level.
keys.ftut.skyisland.2: Training Province opens first, at level 10: daily boss grounds for gold and glyph fragments.
keys.ftut.skyisland.3: Emberdraft at 25: draft heroes, outlast seven rivals. The Swarm Spire at 40: one hero, endless swarm.
keys.ftut.skyisland.4: Tap a trial on the map to enter it. Grow stronger, boys. They'll wait.
keys.ftut.province.1: Two grounds: Gold Province, and Drill Province from level 15. Twelve bosses on each, harder every step.
keys.ftut.province.2: Each gives 2 plays a day, and a loss costs nothing. Gold pays gold. Drill pays glyph fragments.
keys.ftut.province.3: Clear a stage once, then Sweep (1 play) takes your best cleared stage's reward without the fight. Efficient.
keys.ftut.emberdraft.1: Emberdraft. Buy heroes from a shared shop, merge three to rank them up, outlast seven rivals. My game.
keys.ftut.emberdraft.2: 3 attempts a day, and starting a match uses one. More cost diamonds: 3 for 100, then 3 more for 150.
keys.ftut.emberdraft.3: Tap PLAY VS NPCs to begin. Leave in the middle and the match is saved for later.
keys.ftut.guild.1: The Guild Hall! Create a guild or join one. Music always sounds better with a crowd.
keys.ftut.guild.2: Contribute gives 200 gold for guild exp, up to 20 times a day. A guild is only as strong as what you give it.
keys.ftut.guild.3: Raid gives every member 3 attempts a day. Embassy opens once the guild reaches level 4.
keys.ftut.guild.4: Skyfall is the guild war, every other week. You'll find it here too.
keys.ftut.skyfall.1: Skyfall. Destroy 3 enemy citadels to win. Lines march only across their own bridge.
keys.ftut.skyfall.2: Edit Team, then Add Line. Each line is five heroes. Give me the front of one.
keys.ftut.skyfall.3: In Planning, your leader and officers place each member on a citadel. Then the war goes live.
keys.ftut.skyfall.4: Check the Schedule for when lines lock and when the last bell rings!
keys.ftut.watchtower.1: The Watch Tower. My favourite place in town. You see them coming before they arrive.
keys.ftut.watchtower.2: The Attack, Defend and Scout tabs show your marches and your guildmates', with their timers.
keys.ftut.watchtower.3: Not in a guild? Then you only see yourself. Reported entries fade after 10 minutes.
keys.ftut.wall.1: The City Wall. Three lines of defence, up to five heroes each. I take the front. I always take the front.
keys.ftut.wall.2: Tap Edit to set each line. Whoever attacks your city has to break them in order.
keys.ftut.wall.3: World, top right, opens the world map: other cities, mines, raids. Plenty of room to move.
keys.ftut.wall.4: Moving region is free once a month. After that it costs 1,000 diamonds.
keys.ftut.world.1: The world map. Tap a city and Scout it before you Attack. Never walk in blind.
keys.ftut.world.2: Group Attack brings your guild along. Declare War gives them 30 minutes to stand and face us.
keys.ftut.world.3: Mines pay resources, so send miners out to one. And Defend sends help to a friend's city.
keys.ftut.world.4: A Peace Shield from the Market keeps attackers away for 12 hours. Use one before you sleep.
keys.ftut.hut.1: The Witches Hut. Heroes keep their wounds after world fights, and this cauldron mends them.
keys.ftut.hut.2: Tap Heal on one hero, or Heal All to spend brew on the strongest first.
keys.ftut.hut.3: A hero out marching can't be healed. Bring them home first.
keys.ftut.hut.4: Upgrade Hut costs resources and brew. Its level can never pass yours. I heal fine on my own.
keys.ftut.tech.1: The Academy. Patient study, and the strength it gives touches every hero you own.
keys.ftut.tech.2: Pick a track: Attack Power, Health, Armor, Crit and more. Then tap Learn to begin the research.
keys.ftut.tech.3: It costs gold and four resources and takes real time. Only one research runs at once.
keys.ftut.tech.4: No track can pass the Academy's own level, so raise the Academy too. It pays resources every hour.
keys.ftut.forge.1: The Forge. Good steel and a hot fire. I like it here.
keys.ftut.forge.2: Gear is built on a hero's Equipment tab from gear fragments. Those only drop in the Vault.
keys.ftut.forge.3: Here you Temper it: each level adds 2.5% to its stats, up to 30, paid in Forge Dust.
keys.ftut.forge.4: Careful, love: once gear is equipped, it belongs to that hero forever.
keys.ftut.temple.1: The Temple of Ash. Only heroes of Purple ascension or higher may pray here.
keys.ftut.temple.2: Choose a hero, then tap Pray. One prayer rolls all four of that hero's bars at once.
keys.ftut.temple.3: Bars can rise or fall. Like the roll? Save. Hate it? Cancel. Either way the price is spent.
keys.ftut.temple.4: One Free prayer a day, then gold, then diamonds. Multi pray runs up to ten in a row.
keys.ftut.well.1: The Starless Well. Once every 72 hours you may walk into the dark. Bring something warm.
keys.ftut.well.2: Each step, pick a square in the next column: a fight, a chest, a tent with a loaned hero, or a spring.
keys.ftut.well.3: Health and energy carry from fight to fight. The fallen stay down until you raise them.
keys.ftut.well.4: The first resurrection is free, then 50 diamonds. Beat the boss and choose Normal or Hard.
keys.ftut.well.5: The end pays 2% of your level's XP on Normal and 4% on Hard. Hard opens at level 75.
keys.ftut.elite.1: Elite is open. Same roads, harder enemies. Good.
keys.ftut.elite.2: Tap Elite at the bottom of the campaign map. Each Elite chapter opens after that chapter's 10th Normal stage.
keys.ftut.elite.3: Each Elite stage costs 12 stamina and pays its rewards 3 times a day.
keys.ftut.veteran.1: Veteran is open. You cleared Elite 1-10, so the third road begins.
keys.ftut.veteran.2: Same 12 stamina and 3 rewarded runs a day, but Veteran pays double hero fragments.
keys.ftut.veteran.3: Double the fragments, double the fight. Even better.
keys.ftut.bonus.1: A Bonus stage! Clear certain Normal stages, like 1-3, and a Bonus stage opens beside them on the map.
keys.ftut.bonus.2: No stamina and no daily limit. Your heroes split across three roads, and two roads must survive.
keys.ftut.bonus.3: Every Bonus stage you clear makes glyph fragments each hour, and it holds up to 36 hours of them.
keys.ftut.bonus.4: Collect them with the button at the bottom left of the map. Don't let them pile up.
keys.ftut.affinity.1: Affinities, top right of the campaign map. Elements and classes beat one another.
keys.ftut.affinity.2: Water beats Fire, Fire beats Ice, Ice beats Nature, Nature beats Lightning, Lightning beats Water.
keys.ftut.affinity.3: Light and Dark beat each other. The winner deals 20% more damage, the loser 20% less back.
keys.ftut.affinity.4: Classes too: Support beats Tank, Tank beats Marksman, and around it goes. Open the chart. Then fight.
keys.ftut.heroes.1: Your heroes. Every one of them earned their place in this line.
keys.ftut.heroes.2: Hero fragments drop from stages and shops. Gather enough and SUMMON NOW brings a new friend.
keys.ftut.heroes.3: Already have the hero? Open them and spend fragments on Star Up: fill each pip, then confirm the star.
keys.ftut.heroes.4: Inside each hero: Stats, Skills, Glyphs and Equipment. Every tab makes them stronger.
keys.ftut.xp.1: XP Potions! Open the Stats tab and use the Level with XP Potions panel.
keys.ftut.xp.2: Minor gives 60 XP, Greater 300, Major 1,000, Superior 2,500. Tap one and the hero drinks it.
keys.ftut.xp.3: Type an amount in the box to use many at once. No hero can rise past your Commander level.
keys.ftut.xp.4: Every rewarded campaign run drops one. Don't hoard them.
keys.ftut.glyph.1: Glyphs. Six slots on every hero, each glyph cut from glyph fragments.
keys.ftut.glyph.2: Tap a slot to build its glyph. Quick Slot builds all six at once if you hold the fragments.
keys.ftut.glyph.3: Once built, a glyph is locked in for good. No gold, no diamonds. Only fragments.
keys.ftut.glyph.4: All six filled? ASCEND raises the hero's quality and uses up all six. Then the next six begin!
keys.ftut.glyph.5: Fragments drop on Normal stages, in the Vault, from Bonus stages and the Training Province.
keys.ftut.skills.1: Skills! Tap + beside a skill to raise it. The gold price is written on the button.
keys.ftut.skills.2: A skill can never pass its hero's level. Level the hero first, then the skill.
keys.ftut.skills.3: New skills wake with quality: the green at Green, the blue at Blue, the passive at Purple.
keys.ftut.gear.1: Equipment. Nine slots, and each piece is built right here from gear fragments the Vault drops.
keys.ftut.gear.2: Tap a slot and Quick Build if you hold the fragments. Equipped gear stays with that hero for good.
keys.ftut.gear.3: Then take it to the Forge and Temper it with Forge Dust. The Forge opens at level 25.
keys.ftut.set_on: Show a short guide the first time you open each feature
keys.ftut.set_replayed: Guides reset. Each one plays again the next time you open its feature.
keys.bb.sign_in: Sign in to view server rankings.
keys.bb.no_record_emberdraft: Emberdraft keeps no lasting record of first places yet.
keys.bb.nobody_yet: No one is ranked here yet.
keys.set2.test_made: Test account made. Username: {name} · Password: {pass} - shown once, write it down.
keys.set2.test_arena_kept: Arena rank unchanged - a test account never takes a real player's place
keys.bonus13.coach.pick: Pick your squad. Bring up to fifteen if you have them. We'll split them across three roads.
keys.bonus13.coach.roads: Top, Middle, Bottom. Drag a hero to a road, or tap the hero and then the road. All three fight at once.
keys.bonus13.coach.goal: Five waves. Get at least two roads home.
keys.bonus13.coach.zoom: Hard to see who's where? Tap Zoom to bring the fight closer. You can pinch or use the mouse wheel, too.
keys.bonus13.coach.zoom_gesture: Hard to see who's where? Pinch or use the mouse wheel to bring the fight closer.
keys.bonus13.coach.boon: A firebreak. Choose one boon for each road still fighting, then confirm.
keys.bonus13.coach.cross: Now send help where it's needed. Drag a hero across, or tap the hero and then the road. Their boon goes with them.
